test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 30 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Ramesh has borrowed an amount of Rs. 2,00,000 from a bank to start a business. How much simple interest will he pay at acrate of 11% per annum after 2 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2,00,000

Rate (r) = 11% per annum

Time (t) = 2 years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = P × r × t / 100

**Calculation:**

SI = 2,00,000 × 11 × 2 / 100

⇒ SI = 2,00,000 × 22 / 100

⇒ SI = 2,00,000 × 0.22

⇒ SI = 44,000

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**
